def rle_encode(s):
    """Run-length encode a string: "aaabcc" -> [("a", 3), ("b", 1), ("c", 2)]."""
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        j = i
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == s[i]:

        out.append((s[i], j - i))
        i = j
    return out

import os


def newest_file(folder):
    """Name of the most recently modified file in folder, or None if it has no files."""
    names = os.listdir(folder)

    files = [name for name in names if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(folder, name))]
